text:
Brett Howden has 8 goals in 25 games, after 12 in 58 last season, and the scoring is backed by better looks. His own chances are worth 1.12 expected goals per 60, up from 0.62 a year ago, and 8 goals on 7.1 expected is close to fair. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him taking 1.6 shots per 60 off passes across the slot or from behind the net last season, the kind that go in 25% of the time.

The rest of the picture is weaker. At 5v5 Vegas has 47.7% of the attempts and 49% of the expected goals with him on the ice, and the team has scored 7.8 fewer goals than the chances deserve with him out there, which has cost him points: 12 so far, none on the power play.

He has been on the end of some Jack Eichel passes lately. Jesse Granger of The Athletic called Eichel's setup for Howden's Nov. 17 goal against Dallas "an incredible no-look, backhand pass," and two nights later Jake Oettinger robbed him on a 2-on-1 with Eichel. He then had a goal and an assist in Winnipeg on Nov. 21.
